systems.system: Registre de l'état civil / système d'enregistrement des faits d'état civil
systems.country_label: registre de l'état civil; registre national de l'état civil; registre communal de l'état civil et des personnes physiques
systems.owner: Ministère en charge de l'état civil (supplies registers, equipment, installation and maintenance, Article 65); kept by civil-status officers, the mayor acting in the name of the State
systems.tiers: Principal civil-status centres at the seats of urban and rural communes, charged with data entry and electronic archiving (Article 59); secondary centres in quartiers, districts and villages; embassies and consulates

note: A civil-status statute of 25 October 2023: it defines a centralised computer register and charges commune centres with electronic entry and archiving, an application in law only; it states no connection at any commune office.
